question: Under what condition should the teacher grant the boon of long life?
premises: The recipient must be thoroughly examined
Examination should be done always or carefully
Only then may long life be given
inference: Long life should be granted only after careful examination of the recipient.
uncertainties: The object and syntax of dadyāccirajīvitam are compressed in transmission.
plain_english: Having always examined him well, one who would give him long life.
